WHAT'S INSIDE

8 Clinically-Dosed Ingredients. Zero Fillers.

Every ingredient is at the exact dose used in the published research. Not a "proprietary blend." Not a pixie dust amount. The real dose.

Ashwagandha KSM-66®600mgCortisol Suppression

The most clinically studied form of ashwagandha. In a 2019 double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, KSM-66 reduced serum cortisol by 27.9% in 8 weeks. This is the exact dose and form used in the research - not a cheaper extract.

Chandrasekhar et al., 2019 - 27.9% cortisol reduction

Phosphatidylserine
200mgCortisol Suppression

A phospholipid that blunts the HPA axis stress response. Shown to reduce cortisol by 20% in exercise-induced stress models. Particularly effective at reducing the cortisol spike that triggers evening cravings.

Starks et al., 2008 - 20% cortisol reduction

Rhodiola Rosea
400mgCortisol Suppression

An adaptogen that modulates the stress response at the adrenal level. Shown to reduce cortisol-to-DHEA ratio - a key biomarker of adrenal fatigue - while improving energy and cognitive function.

Olsson et al., 2009 - Adrenal fatigue reduction

Magnolia Bark Extract
200mgReceptor Blocking

Contains honokiol and magnolol - compounds that modulate glucocorticoid receptor sensitivity. This means even when cortisol is produced, its downstream effects on hunger hormones are reduced.

Talbott et al., 2013 - Cortisol receptor modulation

L-Theanine
200mgReceptor Blocking

An amino acid from green tea that promotes alpha-wave brain activity - the calm-alert state. Works synergistically with Magnolia Bark to reduce the anxiety component of cortisol without sedation.

Kimura et al., 2007 - Alpha-wave promotion

Berberine HCl
500mgHunger Restoration

A compound that activates AMPK - the metabolic master switch. Shown to reduce ghrelin (hunger hormone) by 18% and improve leptin sensitivity. This is what stops the 9pm kitchen pull.

Zhang et al., 2020 - 18% ghrelin reduction

Chromium Picolinate
200mgHunger Restoration

Enhances insulin sensitivity and reduces carbohydrate cravings. Cortisol drives insulin resistance - chromium helps restore the insulin-glucose axis that cortisol disrupts.

Anton et al., 2008 - Carb craving reduction

Magnesium Glycinate
300mgHunger Restoration

The most bioavailable form of magnesium. 68% of Americans are deficient - and magnesium deficiency directly elevates cortisol. This form crosses the blood-brain barrier to support sleep architecture.

Abbasi et al., 2012 - Sleep quality improvement

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Frequently Asked Questions

How is this different from other cortisol supplements?
Most cortisol supplements contain one or two adaptogens at sub-clinical doses. Cortisol Detox uses eight clinically-dosed ingredients that address all three mechanisms simultaneously - cortisol production, cortisol receptor sensitivity, and hunger hormone restoration. This is why it works when single-ingredient products don't.
How long until I see results?
Most users report food noise quieting in week 2. Evening cravings typically reduce by week 3–4. Visible weight changes happen between weeks 6–12. The cortisol research uses a 60–90 day window - which is why we recommend the 3-bottle bundle and offer a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Do I need to follow a diet?
No. Cortisol Detox is designed to work without dietary restriction. The formula addresses the hormonal drivers of overeating - when cortisol normalizes, hunger hormones rebalance, and you naturally eat less without willpower. That said, if you want to eat healthier, the reduced food noise makes it significantly easier.
Is this safe with meds?
Cortisol Detox contains natural botanical ingredients at clinical doses. However, if you're taking meds — particularly for blood sugar, blood pressure, or thyroid conditions — please consult your healthcare provider before starting. Ashwagandha can interact with thyroid meds.
What if it doesn't work for me?
You're covered by our 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee. If you don't experience a meaningful reduction in food noise, cravings, and weight - or if you're not satisfied for any reason - we'll refund your full purchase price. No questions asked. No hoops.
Why does the 3-bottle bundle work better?
The cortisol research consistently uses 60–90 day protocols. The first month addresses acute cortisol elevation. Months 2–3 complete the deep hormonal reset. Most users see their best results in weeks 8–12. The 3-bottle bundle ensures you complete the full protocol - and it's the most cost-effective option.
Is this for women only?
The formula was developed specifically for the hormonal profile of women aged 35–60, where cortisol-driven weight gain is most prevalent. The ingredients are safe for men, but the research context and dosing were optimized for women.
What are the ingredients?
Ashwagandha KSM-66® (600mg), Phosphatidylserine (200mg), Rhodiola Rosea (400mg), Magnolia Bark Extract (200mg), L-Theanine (200mg), Berberine HCl (500mg), Chromium Picolinate (200mcg), Magnesium Glycinate (300mg). No proprietary blends. No fillers. Every ingredient at the dose used in the published research.
